summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a PDMR shareholding disclosure under EU/UK market abuse regimes. The notification covers a disposal of 9,000 ordinary shares by President of Integrated Gas Cederic Cremers at EUR 35.825 per share for a total of EUR 322,425, executed outside a trading venue on May 8, 2026. This is an insider dealing disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms or corporate event are present; it is a routine regulatory notification by the issuer. No further action or risk-arb angle arises.
